nodes.description: Constant bytes32 IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT storing the EIP-1967 proxy implementation address.
Constant bytes32 ADMIN_SLOT storing the EIP-1967 proxy admin address.
Proxy fallback() payable external, forwards to _fallback().
Proxy receive() payable external, forwards to _fallback().
Abstract virtual _implementation() returning implementation address in Proxy.
_delegate(address) internal: inline assembly delegatecall with full calldata/gas forwarding.
Abstract virtual _willFallback() hook in Proxy.
_fallback() internal: contract/gas check for plain ETH, then _willFallback and _delegate(_implementation()).
BaseUpgradeabilityProxy._implementation() override reading IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT by sload.
_upgradeTo(address) internal: sets implementation and emits Upgraded.
_setImplementation(address) internal: requires contract code, sstores into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
ifAdmin modifier: executes body when msg.sender == _admin(), otherwise falls through to _fallback().
admin() external ifAdmin returning _admin().
implementation() external ifAdmin returning _implementation().
changeAdmin(address) external ifAdmin: rejects zero address, emits AdminChanged, calls _setAdmin.
upgradeTo(address) external ifAdmin calling _upgradeTo.
upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes) payable external ifAdmin: upgrades then delegatecalls attacker-supplied data.
_admin() internal view reading ADMIN_SLOT by sload.
_setAdmin(address) internal: sstores new admin into ADMIN_SLOT.
BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy._willFallback() override requiring msg.sender != admin.
UpgradeabilityProxy constructor: asserts slot hash, sets implementation and delegatecalls init data.
AdminUpgradeabilityProxy constructor: asserts admin slot hash, sets admin, passes logic/data to base.
AdminUpgradeabilityProxy._willFallback() override calling super._willFallback().
InitializableUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize(address,bytes) payable, guarded only by implementation == 0, delegatecalls _data.
InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize(address,address,bytes) payable, sets logic then admin, delegatecalls data.
OpenZeppelinUpgradesAddress.isContract(address) view using extcodesize.
msg.sender used in _fallback for the isContract/gas receive-only shortcut.
msg.sender used in the ifAdmin modifier authorization check against _admin().
msg.sender used in BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy._willFallback() to block the admin from the fallback.
delegatecall(gas(), implementation, ...) in _delegate: executes arbitrary implementation code in proxy storage context.
newImplementation.delegatecall(data) in upgradeToAndCall with caller-supplied calldata.
_logic.delegatecall(_data) inside UpgradeabilityProxy constructor.
_logic.delegatecall(_data) inside initialize(), callable by anyone while implementation slot is zero.
sstore(IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT, newImplementation): raw storage write of the logic address.
sstore(ADMIN_SLOT, newAdmin): raw storage write of the privilege-bearing admin address.
bytes32(uint256(keccak256(...)) - 1) subtraction used in slot assertion; arithmetic on hashed constants.
